      Learn About Costco Technical & Warranty Services

      Delivery, in a box, to the room of choice. It does NOT include set up, installation, or package removal.

      Costco Technical and Warranty Services - TVs

      *Our delivery coverage is within 50-miles of a Costco Wholesale warehouse (some exceptions apply). Orders shipped to Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico may have an additional shipping and handling charge calculated and applied at checkout. To confirm availability in your area, enter the delivery zip code at the top of the item page.

      Basic setup is available for an additional fee and includes:
      • Attach to the manufacturer's provided base.
      • Connect to power and one video source.
      • Packaging removal.
      • NOT INCLUDED: wall mounting, connection to a home theater, or in-wall wire concealment.

      If you are shipping this item to the State of California, a California Electronic Waste Recycling fee will apply to your order at checkout.

      Purchasers in Washington may obtain information about recycling TVs, monitors, and desktop and laptop computers by visiting www.ecyclewashington.org.

      Costco.com products can be returned to any of our more than 800 Costco warehouses worldwide.

      Costco will accept returns within 90 days (from the date the member receives the merchandise) for this product.
